notes: The supplied copula is placed on ἐκ, the first prepositional predicate, under rule 53; reading is with παράκλησις would take the copula off English word order, which rule 53 refuses. The unit is discontinuous around not (rule 15).
Variant SBLGNT.1TH.2.3.v001 (r00-base, covering s008) changes nothing: οὐδέ is realized by nor either way.
